newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to rule soon on Bell Atlantic-NYNEX - source.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to rule soon on Bell Atlantic-NYNEX - source.

text.p: The Justice Department is poised to rule soon on whether to approve the $23 billion merger of Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp, a source familiar with the case said Thursday.
The merger would create the second-largest U.S. telecommunications company, behind only AT&T Corp.
The decision by the Justice Department's Antitrust Division is expected some time this month and could come very soon, according to the source, who requested anonymity.
A Justice Department spokeswoman declined comment on the matter.

Approval by the Justice Department would remove another major obstacle to the deal, which was announced a year ago. New York regulators approved the merger last month after imposing a number of conditions on the transaction.
The Justice Department decision is expected to influence the Federal Communications Commission, which also must sign off on the merger.
The merged companies would rank 23rd on Fortune magazine's list of the 500 largest U.S. corporations.
